description:
Use this when you need an auditable nationwide count with explicit workweek semantics. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the workweek or employer/shift scope is unknown.
What it computes: Counts working and non-working dates in Uzbekistan's pinned 2026 schedule for a required workweek variant.
Example user requests: Count five-day Uzbekistan working days from 2026-05-25 to 2026-06-02.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); workweek (integer); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-05-25","end_date":"2026-06-02","workweek":5,"include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, workweek, weekly_rest_model, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/uzbekistan-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/uzbekistan-working-days-between.md

workweek.description: Required official schedule variant: 5 for Saturday-Sunday rest, or 6 for Sunday-only rest.

name: count_uzbekistan_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Nationwide 2026 statutory and PF-257 schedule scope.

day_type.description: Official weekend, statutory holiday, additional rest, transferred rest, special working day or regular workday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Whether the date is working under the selected official workweek variant.

substitute_day_policy.description: Published transfers only; no employer/shift inference.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Uzbekistan Working Days
